body:
## Quick answer

For Diwali, most women wear a **suit set (kurta, pants and dupatta)** or an **Anarkali** in a festive colour – red, maroon, gold, royal blue, emerald, plum or pastels with gold work. Choose a lighter cotton or chanderi suit for the daytime puja and a richer georgette, taffeta or velvet Anarkali for the evening party. Avoid all-white or all-black if the family is traditional.

## Puja or party: what to wear

| Diwali moment | Outfit | Colours | Fabric |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lakshmi puja at home | Embroidered suit set with a dupatta | Red, maroon, yellow, peach | Cotton, chanderi |
| Diwali card party | Flared Anarkali | Royal blue, emerald, plum | Georgette, taffeta silk |
| Office Diwali | Block print kurta set | Pastels, indigo | Cotton |
| Cold evening abroad | Velvet Anarkali or suit with a shawl | Wine, black and gold | Velvet |

## Suit set or Anarkali?

A **suit set** is easy to sit in for a long puja and to wear again later. An **Anarkali** twirls in photos and feels dressier for a party. If you are going to more than one event, choose one of each – or one Anarkali and change the dupatta and jewellery.

## Diwali abroad

In the UK, Canada and the northern USA Diwali is often cold. A velvet Anarkali, or a suit with a warm shawl and thermal leggings, keeps you festive and warm – see [velvet Anarkalis for winter](/blog/velvet-anarkali-for-winter-weddings-how-to-choose-style-and-care/). Check the **last order dates** for your country on our [festival calendar](/festival/).

faq.q: What colour suit should I wear on Diwali?
faq.a: Red, maroon and gold are the traditional Diwali colours. Royal blue, emerald, plum and pastels with gold work are popular too. Many families avoid all-white or all-black for the puja.

faq.q: Is a cotton suit festive enough for Diwali?
faq.a: Yes – an embroidered or block print cotton suit with a festive dupatta looks right for a puja and is far more comfortable than heavy fabrics.

faq.q: Suit set or Anarkali for a Diwali party?
faq.a: Both work. An Anarkali feels dressier and twirls in photos; a suit set is easier to sit in and wear again.

faq.q: When should I order for Diwali delivery abroad?
faq.a: About 3 weeks before Diwali for ready sizes and about 4 weeks for custom fit. Our festival calendar shows the exact last order date for each country.
